policy: blob fingerprint tracks unchanged source. CI coverage means tested changes only, not full source inspection; changed blobs automatically reopen.
audit_in_progress: Core-to-physical-MachineIR migration: five targets now have production typed selection entrypoints, but complete function admission, ABI parity and full GNU AS/LD/QEMU/Linux runtime acceptance remain separate, unproven gates. LoongArch64 production has 22 typed-output fixtures and one intentionally unsupported legacy case; additional source-ASM UACCESS and LL/SC families have focused proofs. RV32 wide-integer virtio compilation and RV64 GNU source-ASM provenance have focused passing probes; upstream zlib full-TU admission and RV64 checked-overflow selector coverage remain open. Retired Loong emit modules are removed from the active inventory. New source owners are inventory-only; stale fingerprints reopen review and do not imply full-source certification.
